description:
Welcome to Animal Kingdom 3, a hidden animal game where you collect pawprints and cameras while searching for animals in fantastic locations! 
With 3 game modes and trivias, jigsaw, and swap puzzles between the chapters, 
Animal Kingdom 3 will provide hours of fun for hidden object fans in colorful jungles and other natural scenes even underwater! 
Animal Kingdom 3 is waiting for you in this unique hidden object game!

- Replayable hidden animal scenes!
- Animal puzzles along the way!
- Collect photos and curiosities
name: Animal Kingdom 3
intro: Amazing hidden objects quest in world of animals!
